caption: The modulus of a square root; the color turns where its argument does, at 0
e^(ix) has modulus 1 throughout: a flat line whose color runs the full wheel once
|1/(1 + ix)|, a bump whose color slides from cyan to red and back, the argument going from −π/2 to π/2
log x: the argument is π for every negative x and 0 beyond 1, with the zero at 1
|ζ(1/2 + it)| touches 0 at each nontrivial zero, the color turning at each touch
|Γ(it)| decays exponentially, its argument circling more and more rapidly
